skill.name: daily-routine-note-move-tasks
skill.description: Ensure today's routine note exists and carry unchecked tasks from the last routine note.

skill:
task today,yesterday,move,carry,forward,unchecked,last routine
carry forward,carry-over,move unchecked,unchecked tasks
- Use `Today` and `Last routine note` paths from the routine hint. Do not search the vault for calendar yesterday. - Headings = existing `## …` lines from the last routine note only. If there are none, or Last routine note is `Not created`, start with `## Tasks` and invent nothing else. - If Last routine note is `Not created`, the carry-forward list is empty.
- From the last routine note, extract only unchecked task lines matching `- [ ] ...`. - Copy those lines verbatim. Ignore checked tasks (`- [x]`), headings, events, notes, and placeholder text.
- Do not call `read_skill` for `daily-routine-note`. - Keep the last routine note unchanged. - Do not duplicate a task already present in today's note. - Do not call `create_new` when today's note already exists.
### Move unchecked tasks into today's note 1. In one turn, call `read_file` on today's path and, when Last routine note is not `Not created`, `read_file` on that path. 2. If today's note is missing, call `write_file` with `create_new` using headings from `` plus only the verbatim `- [ ]` lines from ``. 3. If today's note exists, call `write_file` with `overwrite` or `append` only to add carried-forward tasks. 4. Stop after that write, or if there is nothing to add. Do not search the vault or load another routine skill.
